content: For the ScRNN model, we use a single-layer Bi-LSTM with a hidden dimension size of 50. The input representation consists of 198 dimensions, which is thrice the number of unique characters (66) in the vocabulary. We cap the vocabulary size to 10K words, whereas we use the entire vocabulary of 78470 words when we backoff to the background model. For training these networks, we corrupt the movie reviews according to all attack types, i.e., applying one of the 4 attack types to each word, and trying to reconstruct the original words via cross entropy loss.
